title: Feature - new SMS command LOOP CLOSED/LGS
body:
Hi!

I came up with an idea to create new SMS command to be able to remotely change Loop mode Closed <-> LGS.
I found it very useful when my daughter is at school.

I created PR #2237 for that.
Please have a look and let me know if that would be ok, maybe something else to be added?

Kind regards!
Piotr Zadroga

comments.body: PR #2237 was merged to DEV branch. Closing this issue.
